page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL

A reconnaissance or 7th Section of the
Headquarters of Sibvo (Siberian Military District)
--------------------------------------------------

Although one of the doors on the third floor of
the premises of the Headquarters of Sibvo (Novo-Nikolaevsk)
bears a sign "Chief of the Reconnoissance Section" and
"Admission strictly prohibited", only one man functions
there named Bogatireff, who is Assistant Chief of the
Section and who carries out exclusively secret work.
The Headquarters of the Section, together with its
Chief named Nicholai Samuilovich, are in Vladivostock
on the Lenin Street (formerly Svetlanka) right over the
"Textile Syndicate". There is no sign board at the door ,
but one can hear during the day the sound of typewriter
emanating from the flat occupied by one Livshits (Yliya
Yakovlevich) and one Beloff. The entrance door to this
flat is always fastened and no person is admitted into
the hall without ringing the bell. This hall has three
doors one leading to the flat of Beloff, the other to that
of Livshits and the third into the office of the 7th Section,
the doors of the latter being also always fastened. The
room next to the office is that of the Chief, and this latter
has a dark chamber for photographic purposes and a laboratory
for the examination of chemicals to be used for secret
writing. As above said this flat is occupied by the Chief
and his assistant. The rest of the assistants and employees
of the 7th Section live at No. 74 Leninskaya Street, next
to the building of the Military and Naval Institution.
The Staff of the office of the 7th Section is:-
I Chief
2 Assistants
I Interpreter, a Korean.
I Typist
2 Red Army men.
All the above mentioned persons are directly connected
with the work of the Section in the office. But there are
many more agents. For instance one of the assistants
named Babicheff is officially connected with the Commercial
Agency of the Ussuri Railway (Uks) as Manager and another
named Turinsky, is at the Pogranichnaya Railway Station
employed as a clerk at the Railway Cars exchange office
of the Ussuri Railway.
The Chief of the 7th Section is also Manager of the
Bureau dealing with Export and Import of Beans and their
assortment, attached to the Ussuri Railway.
Two men named Kushnir and Demensky respectively are
working in the Bureau of Foreign Ships service. The
latter resides at Leninskaya Street No. 98.
Assistants of the 7th Section work in other institutions
partly through the inability of the 7th Section to pay high
wages, and are thus able to earn more in their respective
positions in addition to being able to get good information
from foreign sources.
In addition to the Staff interpreter there is also
a Russian student of the State Far Eastern University, in
which the teacher of military discipline, is also connected
with the 7th Section. The names of the 2 last named men are
unknown.
In centres of the activities of smugglers, on the
borders of Russia and foreign territory, there are agents
from amongst residents of the 7th Section.

（左侧竖排批注：大九年十月十九日）

关于西伯利亚军区（Sibvo）总部
第7科（侦察科）的侦察报告
--------------------------------------------------

虽然西伯利亚军区（Sibvo）总部所在地（新尼古拉耶夫斯克）
三楼的一扇门上挂着“侦察科科长”和
“严禁入内”的牌子，但那里只有一名
叫博加蒂列夫（Bogatireff）的人在办公，他是该科的
副科长，专门从事秘密工作。
该科总部及其名为尼古拉·萨穆伊洛维奇（Nicholai Samuilovich）的
科长位于符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的列宁街（前斯维特兰卡街），
就在“纺织辛迪加”楼上。门口没有招牌，
但在白天可以听到从利夫希茨（伊利亚·雅科夫列维奇）和
贝洛夫（Beloff）居住的公寓里传出打字机的声音。
这所公寓的入口门总是锁着的，不按门铃任何人
都不准进入大厅。这个大厅有三扇门，一扇通向
贝洛夫的公寓，另一扇通向利夫希茨的公寓，第三扇
通向第7科的办公室，后者的门也总是锁着的。
办公室旁边的房间是科长的房间，后者设有一个用于
摄影目的的暗室和一个用于检查用于密写的化学药品的
实验室。如上所述，这套公寓由科长和他的助手居住。
第7科的其他助手和雇员住在列宁斯卡亚街74号，
紧邻军事和海军机构大楼。
第7科办公室的人员编制如下：
1名 科长
2名 助手
1名 翻译，朝鲜人。
1名 打字员
2名 红军战士。
上述所有人员都直接与办公室内的科室工作有关。但还有
更多的特工。例如，一名名叫巴比切夫（Babicheff）的助手
在乌苏里铁路（Uks）商业代理机构正式任职，担任经理，
另一名名叫图林斯基（Turinsky）的助手在波格拉尼奇纳亚火车站
受雇于乌苏里铁路的车厢交换办公室，担任职员。
第7科科长还兼任附属于乌苏里铁路的
豆类进出口及分类局的经理。
两名分别名为库什尼尔（Kushnir）和德缅斯基（Demensky）的人
在外轮服务局工作。后者居住在列宁斯卡亚街98号。
第7科的助手在其他机构工作，部分原因是第7科
无力支付高薪，因此他们能够在各自的职位上
赚取更多收入，同时还能从外国来源获取良好情报。
除了 staff 翻译外，还有一名国立远东大学
的俄国学生，该校的军纪教官也与第7科有关联。
最后这两名男子的姓名不详。
在走私活动的中心，即俄罗斯与外国领土的
边境地区，有来自第7科居民中的特工。

（左侧竖排批注：庄文及以下之附件全部正体）
（左侧竖排批注：大九年十月十九日）

- 2 -

In Possiet there is a Korean named Pak Semen, in
Poltavka, name unknown, in Grodekovo one Stepan, Secretary
of the District Committee, who resides at the Electric Power
Station. This latter has at his disposal for communication
with Pogranichnaya one Stepan Naumenko (nicknamed Noroff),
who whilst smuggling goods carries through from Russian
territory and from Pogranichnaya too various packages
for which he gets paid every time 10 roubles.
I do not know the agents at Imat and in Blagoveschensk.
At Pogranichnaya the following are agents for the 7th Section:-
Onopa, employee of the Ussuri Railway, Malashko, Inspector
of the Railway Committee, and a White named Diba alias Diada
Yasha, as well as a Korean(name unknown) who owns a bycicle
shop.
Turninsky used to be at Pogranichnaya before, but later
escaped to Russia. He was in charge of Smirnoff, Secretary
of the Consulate, who deals with matters of the 7th Section.
He is also representative of of the 3rd Administration of
the Komintern Headquarters, G.P.U.
At Imanpo there is a Korean doctor, whose brother
Pak is in Vladivostock with the 7th Section. In Kirin there
is one Kuznetsoff. It is difficult to say exactly who is
still working in these places as a great many have been
arrested in January last such as Sumsky and others.
In North Manchuria the work of the G.P.U. and Komintern
is conducted by Znamensky, Soviet Vice Consul at Harbin.
The reconnaissance work is in charge of one named Nicholai,
who resides at No. 15 Bolshoi Prospect.
The connection maintained between the Consulate
and the agents and sub-agents has been in charge of one
"Vanko", Ivan Ivanovich Petroff, a Bulgarian, who participated
in the explosion of a Cathedral. He seems to have gone to
Russia now.
Michailoff, Assistant Chief of the Commercial Section
on C.E.R. is an agent of the G.P.U.
Kuznetzoff would be able to tell who is in Tsitsihar
and Hailar. He is now in Kirin, but was in the above places
before for a long time.
Liaison with Chinese territory and Russia is maintained
in the following manner: All information from the towns
of North China first comes to Harbin and from here it is
either forwarded through couriers, who have season tickets
on C.E.R.or else through train conductors, who hand the
staff direct to the sources at Pogranichnaya or Vladivostock.
Then from Pogranichnaya sometimes Naumenko of Grodekovo
takes the information or else again the train conductors
deliver it. Frequently it is being done by Inspector
Pridorogin.
Diplomatic couriers carry information very seldom
and only when it is from the G.P.U. The People's
Commissariat for Foreign Affairs has a clause in the
instructions prohibiting the couriers to carry "ordinary"
mail and so if this is done sometimes, it is through
pure friendly ties. Diplomatic couriers are under G.P.U.
From Russia the mail is forwarded as follows:- Money
and documents are being taken by a messenger as far as
Gnadakovo and are then taken delivery of by Naumenko. Sometimes
it gets direct to Onopa at Pogranichnaya or someone else
to who it is addressed. Letters are taken as far as
Pogranichnaya and here posted to various addresses: the
letters are written in different secret writing, depending
on the staff used. Letters are seldom addressed direct
to agents, as a rule they are addressed to a fictitious
name and are later forwarded to the right persons.
Agents are usually sent abroad in secret, mostly
through Grodekovo. In Pogranichnaya they get passports

在波西耶特（Possiet）有一名朝鲜人，名叫朴谢苗（Pak Semen），在
波尔塔夫卡（Poltavka）有一人，姓名不详，在格罗杰科沃（Grodekovo）有一人
叫斯捷潘（Stepan），是区委员会秘书，居住在发电站。
后者有一名斯捷潘·瑙缅科（Stepan Naumenko）（绰号诺罗夫 Noroff）
供其支配，用于与波格拉尼奇纳亚联络，此人
在走私货物时，每次从俄罗斯领土和波格拉尼奇纳亚
运送各种包裹，每次收取10卢布报酬。
我不知道在伊曼（Imat）和布拉戈维申斯克（Blagoveschensk）的特工情况。
在波格拉尼奇纳亚，第7科的特工如下：
奥诺帕（Onopa），乌苏里铁路雇员，马拉什科（Malashko），铁路委员会
督察，以及一名白俄分子迪巴（Diba），别名佳佳·亚沙（Diada Yasha），
还有一名朝鲜人（姓名不详），拥有一家自行车店。
图林斯基以前在波格拉尼奇纳亚，但后来逃往俄罗斯。
他由领事馆秘书斯米尔诺夫（Smirnoff）负责，后者处理
第7科的事务。他还是共产国际总部、国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）
第三管理局的代表。
在伊曼波（Imanpo）有一名朝鲜医生，其兄弟
朴某在符拉迪沃斯托克与第7科在一起。在吉林有一人
叫库兹涅佐夫（Kuznetsoff）。很难确切说明谁还在这些地方
工作，因为去年一月许多人被捕，如苏姆斯基（Sumsky）等人。
在北满，国家政治保卫总局和共产国际的工作
由驻哈尔滨的苏联副领事兹纳缅斯基（Znamensky）负责。
侦察工作由一名叫尼古拉（Nicholai）的人负责，
他住在大 Prospect 街15号。
领事馆与特工及次级特工之间的联络
由一名“万科”（Vanko），即伊万·伊万诺维奇·彼得罗夫（Ivan Ivanovich Petroff）负责，
他是保加利亚人，曾参与炸毁一座大教堂。他似乎
现在已经去了俄罗斯。
米哈伊洛夫（Michailoff），中东铁路商业科副科长，
是国家政治保卫总局的特工。
库兹涅佐夫能够告知谁在齐齐哈尔
和海拉尔。他现在在吉林，但以前在上述地方
待了很长时间。
与中国领土和俄罗斯的联络维持方式如下：
来自中国北方各城镇的所有情报首先汇集到哈尔滨，
然后由此通过持有中东铁路季票的信使转发，
或者通过列车乘务员直接交给波格拉尼奇纳亚或
符拉迪沃斯托克的来源。然后从波格拉尼奇纳亚，
有时由格罗杰科沃的瑙缅科传递情报，或者再次
由列车乘务员递送。经常由普里多罗金（Pridorogin）督察执行。
外交信使很少携带情报，仅当情报来自
国家政治保卫总局时才携带。人民外交委员部在
指令中有一条规定，禁止信使携带“普通”邮件，
因此如果有时这样做，那是出于纯粹的友好关系。
外交信使受国家政治保卫总局管辖。
来自俄罗斯的邮件发送方式如下：钱款和文件
由信使带至格纳达科沃（Gnadakovo），然后由瑙缅科接收。
有时直接送到波格拉尼奇纳亚的奥诺帕或其他
指定收件人手中。信件被带至波格拉尼奇纳亚，
在此寄往各个地址：信件根据使用的工作人员
不同，用不同的密写方式书写。信件很少直接
寄给特工，通常寄给一个虚构的名字，然后再
转交给正确的人。
特工通常秘密派往国外，大多
通过格罗杰科沃。在波格拉尼奇纳亚，他们获得护照

page_data.en:
- 3 -

which are prepared for them beforehand and which are
usually made as for emigrants and they then proceed
by rail to the place of appointment. Agents are met
upon arrival at destination and given "shelter" i.e.
some sort of work as a screen and are then instructed
with the existing state of things, etc.
Agents as a rule go to Vladivostock after every
six months for a few days to make a report and to clear
up various matters. They are, however, encouraged to
use their own initiative on the spot of activity, unless
it is a matter of principle.
Once a year at least Chief of the 7th Section goes
to Harbin and summons the agents there for a conference.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

这些护照是预先为他们准备的，通常
做成移民护照的样子，然后他们乘火车
前往指定地点。特工到达目的地后会有人接应，
并提供“掩护”，即安排某种工作作为伪装，
随后向他们通报当地局势等。
特工通常每六个月去符拉迪沃斯托克几天，
进行汇报并处理各种事务。然而，除非涉及
原则性问题，否则鼓励他们在活动地点发挥
主动性。
第7科科长每年至少去一次哈尔滨，
召集那里的特工开会。

(headquarters of 10vo . . . . . . Military District)

Although one of the doors on the third floor of
the premises of the headquarters of 10vo (10vo-Nikolaevsk
bears a sign "Chief of the reconnaissance section" and
admission strictly prohibited, only a few institutions
are named "Schnurr", who is assistant chief of the
section all the work is carried out exclusively on rail work.
The headquarters of the section, together with its
chief named "Nikolai Smirnov", are in Livestock
on the main track formerly Vetlunar right over the
existing junctions. There is no high wall or any door,
one can enter through the way at the end of typewriter
machines from the first occupied by the civilians (Ilyin
Yakovlevich) and the clerks. A certain door to be
kept always fastened and no person is admitted into
the hall without inquiry. The building is divided into three
rooms: 1 - leading to the file of staff, the other two next
of events as the stairs into the office of the 7th section,
the doors of the outer side, where always fastened. The
room next to the office is that of the chief, and this room
has a dark chamber for photo film processing and a laboratory
for the examination of chemicals to be used for secret
writings. The above said this flat is occupied by the chief
and his assistants. The rest of the assistants and employees
of the 7th section live at No. 7, Leningradskaya street, next
to the building of the military and naval institution.
The staff of the office of the 7th section is:-
1 Chief
2 Assistants
1 Interpreter, a civilian.
1 Typist
2 Red Army men.

All the above mentioned persons are directly connected
with the work of the section in the office. But there are
many more agents. For instance one of the assistants
named Babicheff is officially connected with the manager
agency of the Amur railway. As manager and another
named Turinsky, is at the Ogranichnaya railway station
employed as a clerk at the Railway Cars exchange office
of the Amur railway.
The Chief of the 7th section is also manager of the
Bureau dealing with Export and Import of Beans and their
assortment, attached to the Amur railway.
Two men named Kushnir and Romanovsky respectively are
working in the Bureau of Foreign Ships service. The
latter resides at Leningradskaya street No. 98.
Assistants of the 7th Section work in other institutions
partly through the inability of the 7th section to pay high
wages, and are thus able to earn more in their respective
positions in addition to being able to get good information
from foreign sources.
In addition to the Staff interpreter there is also
a Russian student of the State Far Eastern University, in
which the teacher of military discipline, is also connected
with the 7th Section. The names of the 2 last named men is
unknown.
In consequence of the activities of smugglers, on the
borders of Russia and foreign territory, there are agents
from amongst residents of the 7th Section.

虽然第10vo（10vo-尼古拉耶夫斯克）总部场所三楼的一扇门上挂着“侦察处处长”的牌子，并严禁入内，但只有少数机构被称为“Schnurr”，他是该处的副处长，所有工作 exclusively 在铁路工作上开展。该处总部及其名为“Nikolai Smirnov”的处长位于 Livestock 的主轨道上，以前是 Vetlunar，就在现有的交汇处上方。没有高墙或任何门，人们可以通过由平民（Ilyin Yakovlevich）和职员占据的第一间办公室末端的打字机通道进入。有一扇门必须始终保持锁闭，未经询问不得让任何人进入大厅。该建筑分为三个房间：1 - 通向参谋档案室，另外两个房间通过楼梯通向第7处的办公室，外侧的门始终锁闭。紧邻办公室的房间是处长的房间，这个房间有一个用于冲洗照片胶片的暗室和一个用于检查用于秘密书写的化学品的实验室。如上所述，这套公寓由处长及其助手居住。第7处的其余助手和雇员住在列宁格勒街7号，毗邻军事和海军机构大楼。
第7处办公室的人员编制如下：
1 处长
2 助手
1 翻译，平民。
1 打字员
2 红军战士。

所有上述人员都直接与办公室内的处室工作有关。但还有更多的特工。例如，一名名为 Babicheff 的助手正式隶属于阿穆尔铁路的管理代理机构。作为经理，另一名名为 Turinsky 的人在 Ogranichnaya 火车站受雇于阿穆尔铁路的车辆交换办公室，担任职员。
第7处处长还兼任附属于阿穆尔铁路的豆类进出口及分类局的经理。
两名分别名为 Kushnir 和 Romanovsky 的人在外国船舶服务局工作。后者居住在列宁格勒街98号。
第7处的助手在其他机构工作，部分原因是第7处无力支付高薪，因此他们能够在各自的职位上赚取更多收入，同时还能从外国来源获取良好情报。
除了 staff 翻译外，还有一名国立远东大学的俄罗斯学生，该校的军事纪律教师也与第7处有联系。最后这两名男子的姓名不详。
由于走私者在俄罗斯与外国领土边境的活动，第7处居民中有特工。

Kuznetsoff 能够告知谁在 ..itski.r（原文不清）和 .ailar（原文不清）工作。他现在在 Irin（音译，可能指伊尔库茨克或类似地名），但此前长期在上述两地工作。
与中国领土和俄罗斯的联络按以下方式进行：所有来自中国北方城镇的情报首先汇集到哈尔滨，然后由此通过持有季票的信使转发，或者通过列车乘务员直接将情报递交给位于 .ograniichnaya（波格拉尼奇纳亚/边境站）或 Vladivostock（海参崴/符拉迪沃斯托克）的来源方。
来自 .ograniichnaya（波格拉尼奇纳亚/边境站）的情报有时由 Grodekovo（格罗杰科沃）的 Naumenko 接收，或者再次由列车乘务员递送。这项工作经常由 Tidongin 督察执行。
外交信使很少携带情报，仅当情报来自 ..o.de（原文不清，可能指 GPU/格别乌）时才这样做。人民外交委员部在指令中有一条规定，禁止信使携带普通邮件，因此如果偶尔这样做，也是出于纯粹的私人友好关系。外交信使受 ..o.de（原文不清）管辖。
来自俄罗斯的邮件转发方式如下：钱款和文件由信使带至 Grodekovo（格罗杰科沃），然后由 Naumenko 接收。有时它会直接送达 Pogranichnaya（波格拉尼奇纳亚/边境站）的 Gospa（音译）或其他收件人。信件被带至 Pogranichnaya（波格拉尼奇纳亚/边境站），在此处寄往各个地址；信件使用不同的密写方式书写，具体取决于所使用的人员。信件很少直接寄给代理人，通常寄给一个虚构的名字，然后再转交给正确的人员。
代理人通常秘密派往国外，大多经过 Grodekovo（格罗杰科沃）。在 Pogranichnaya（波格拉尼奇纳亚/边境站），他们获得预先准备好的护照，

which are prepared for the beforehand and which are
usually used as for emigrants and they then proceed
by rail to the place of a settlement. They are met
upon arrival at destination and given shelter i.e.
some sort of work as a foreman and are then instructed
as to the existing state of affairs, etc.
Guests as a rule go to Vladivostok after every
six months for a few days to make a report and to clear
up various matters. They are, however, not urged to
use their own initiative in any sort of activity, unless
it is a matter of principle.
Not a year passes without one of the 70 colonies being
visited and when this occurs there is always a conference.

这些护照通常作为移民护照使用，然后他们乘火车前往定居点。到达目的地后有人接应并为他们提供庇护，即安排某种工头之类的工作，随后向他们通报当前局势等。
客人通常每六个月去一次 Vladivostok（海参崴/符拉迪沃斯托克）几天，以汇报工作并处理各种事务。然而，除非涉及原则性问题，否则不鼓励他们在任何活动中发挥主动性。
每年都会有至少一个这70个殖民地被访问，每当此时，总会召开会议。

The headquarters of the section, together with its
chief named Nicholas Smirnovitch, are in Vladivostock
at No. 10, Svetlanskaya Street, Vladimir House. The
requisite furniture, chairs in the room, etc., are
of the best quality. The day to day work of the section
is carried out by the chief himself. He occupies a
large office which has been fitted out with all
necessary equipment for carrying on his work. In addition
to this he has a large map of the Far East on the wall
which shows the position of the 7th Section.
The office of the chief is also used as a laboratory
for the examination of chemicals to be used for secret
writings. A stove and table are occupied by the chief
and his assistants. The rest of the assistants are employees
of the 7th Section living at No. 7, Svetlanskaya Street, next
to the building of the Military Naval Institution.
The staff of the office of the 7th Section is:-
1 Chief
2 Assistants
1 Interpreter, German.
1 Typist
2 Red Army men.

All the above mentioned persons are directly connected
with the work of the section in the office, but there are
many more agents. For instance one of the assistants
named Babionoff is officially connected with the Siberian
Agency of the Trans-Siberian Railway as manager and another
named Purinsky, is at the communication railway station
employed as a clerk at the military care exchange office
of the Trans-Siberian Railway.
The Chief of the 7th Section is also manager of the
bureau dealing with export and import of goods and their
assortment, attached to the Trans-Siberian Railway.
Two men named Kusmin and Semenov respectively are
working in the bureau of Foreign Ships Service. The
latter resides at Leninskaya Street No. 98.
Assistants of the 7th Section work in other institutions
partly through the inability of the 7th Section to pay high
wages, and are thus able to earn more in their respective
positions in addition to being able to get good information
from foreign sources.
In addition to the staff interpreter there is also
a Russian student of the State Far Eastern University, in
which the teacher of military discipline, is also connected
with the 7th Section. The names of the last named men is
unknown.
In centres of the activities of smugglers, on the
borders of Russia and foreign territory, there are agents
from amongst residents of the 7th Section.

与中国领土和俄罗斯的联络按以下方式维持：来自中国北方城镇的所有信息首先汇集到哈尔滨，然后要么通过信使转发，要么利用车票等手段，或者通过列车乘务员，他们将材料直接交给奥格拉尼奇纳亚（Ogranichnaya）或符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）的来源。从奥格拉尼奇纳亚，有时由普罗杰科沃（Prodekovo）的人取走信息，或者再次由列车乘务员送达。经常由检查员弗拉基米尔（Vladimir）执行此任务。

外交信使很少携带信息，且仅当信息来自中心时才携带。外交人民委员部在指令中有一条款禁止信使携带“普通邮件”，因此如果有时这样做，那是出于纯粹的友好关系。外交信使受……管辖。

从俄罗斯发出的邮件按以下方式转发：金钱和文件由信使带至普罗杰科沃（Prodekovo），然后由萨姆松科（Samsonko）接收。有时它会直接从奥格拉尼奇纳亚到达哈尔滨，或交给其他收件人。信件被带至奥格拉尼奇纳亚，并在此寄往各个地址；信件根据所用人员以不同的密写方式书写。信件很少直接寄给特工，通常寄给虚构的名字，然后再转交给正确的人员。
特工通常秘密派往国外，大多经过普罗杰科沃（Prodekovo）。在奥格拉尼奇纳亚，他们获得护照
